risk_description: Prompt injection via data fields (e.g. product descriptions)
mitigation: Treat all row-level data as untrusted input; strip/neutralize embedded instructions before they reach the model; Guardrail blocks any output that echoes an instruction found in data. Tested against both quoted and unquoted injection attempts (eval ID10).
kri: Injection-category eval pass rate, target 100%, currently 100% (Step 4).
detection_signal: Any single injection-eval failure in a pre-deploy run; any live report of the model appearing to follow instructions from a data field instead of the user.

risk_description: Sensitive-info disclosure / PII surfaced to an unauthorized user
mitigation: access_policy gate plus pii_classifier on every Guardrail pass. Hardened twice from live red-teaming in Step 4: once because the model suggested self-authorization bypass phrases, once because the categorical refusal only surfaced after three escalating attempts instead of the first response.
owner: Security/Compliance (with AI/ML Eng on Guardrail logic)
kri: 0 PII leaks in periodic audit sample; adversarial/PII eval pass rate, target 100%, currently 100%.
detection_signal: Any PII field appearing in a delivered answer during audit sampling; any refusal that takes more than one turn to trigger.

risk_description: Excessive agency - agent writes/deletes data instead of read-only
mitigation: warehouse.query is provisioned SELECT-only at the database credential level, not just a prompt instruction. No DROP/UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT is possible regardless of what the model attempts.
detection_signal: Any non-SELECT statement appearing in query logs. This should be structurally impossible, so even one occurrence is a P0 incident.

risk_description: Over-reliance on a confidently wrong number
mitigation: Four independent confidence triggers (validator disagreement, unresolved ambiguity, cross-check discrepancy, query timeout), Validator's independent second calculation path, mandatory show-the-SQL on every answer.
kri: Eval accuracy, target >=85% overall / 100% adversarial, currently 100% on 20/20 (Step 4).
detection_signal: Any eval regression below the 85% overall or 100% adversarial bar on a pre-deploy run; any user-reported number that does not reconcile against a manual pull.

risk_description: Data-access / authorization failure - wrong user sees wrong data
mitigation: access_policy gate scoped per requesting user's role. Board-level numbers are withheld outright, not just flagged, per the Step 4 hardened rule.
kri: 0 unauthorized cross-scope data exposures in audit sample.
detection_signal: Any answer containing data outside the requester's documented role or permission scope.

risk_description: Semantic layer / instructions drift - a rule is documented but not pasted into the live system prompt, so the model's actual behavior diverges from what is written and tested
mitigation: Any new business rule or metric definition gets written into context-and-tools.md, the live system prompt, and eval-set.csv in the same edit, checked in that order, before the fix is considered done. Per the Step 4 lesson.
kri: Count of "found live, not in spec" incidents per quarter, target trending to 0. 3 occurred during initial build (ID13, ID14, ID15).
detection_signal: Any eval case that fails on first live test after passing a written spec review; any live answer that contradicts a rule documented elsewhere.

risk_description: Validator cross-check tolerance miscalibrated - the +/-2% / +/-2 unit bands let a genuinely wrong number pass silently
mitigation: Tolerances are explicitly labeled as assumptions in the PRD. Recalibrate against real production variance once live data exists, before removing the assumption label.
kri: Cross-check discrepancy rate observed in production vs. the +/-2% / +/-2 unit band.
detection_signal: Any manually-audited answer found wrong that the cross-check did not flag.

risk_description: warehouse.query cost/performance runaway from an overly broad question that slips past the Planner's flag
mitigation: Planner flags obviously broad questions (many variables, long time ranges, multiple groupings) before they run and offers to narrow scope; warehouse.query's 10-second timeout caps worst-case cost per call.
kri: Cost per question at current volume tier vs. the Step 6 cost model projection; count of timeout escalations per week.
detection_signal: Sustained rise in cost-per-question or timeout-escalation rate above the Step 6 baseline.

risk_description: Model/vendor API outage or deprecation breaks answering or silently changes behavior
mitigation: Model choice kept swappable behind the Planner's routing layer rather than hardcoded; monitor the vendor's status page and deprecation notices.
kri: Model API uptime/error rate; days' notice before a deprecation deadline.
detection_signal: Spike in model API error responses; a deprecation notice for the in-use model version.

risk_description: Insufficient observability/audit trail - an incident cannot be reconstructed or proven compliant after the fact
owasp_llm_category: LLM02 (adjacent; not a direct OWASP-LLM match, this is a governance/traceability gap)
mitigation: Log question, plan, SQL, tables used, confidence, latency, and cost on every single answer (per Step 6), retained long enough to reconstruct any incident.
kri: Percent of answers with a complete trace logged, target 100%.
detection_signal: Any answer missing one or more required trace fields in a periodic log audit.

risk_description: Stale or cached result served as current - prior_results_cache misapplied to an open, still-accumulating period
mitigation: prior_results_cache is scoped to closed periods only by design; open, still-accumulating periods are never read from cache.
kri: 0 cache reads against an open period.
detection_signal: Any cache hit whose underlying period is still accumulating data at read time.
